information.description:
Mini Air Drone. Observes and records; only attacks if provoked. Camera with Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, LL/IR/UV, MicroVideo and TeleOptics. A Reflex Co-Processor lets it dodge anything, bullets included. Optional: an air pistol with 8 acid paintballs, a Microwaver (8 shots), or a goop launcher (4 shots, Grenade Launcher table; a hit costs 2d6 MOVE until someone spends an Action clearing it).

Cost: 5,000eb
MOVE: 8
HP: 15
CN: 12
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Militech Rht-1 Moth: 8 acid paintballs

An Exotic Medium Pistol. Fires Paintballs. If loaded with acid it is able to ablate armor by one with each hit.

Militech Rht-1 Moth: 8 shots

No damage. On a hit, the target rolls DV15 Cybertech or the GM switches off 2 pieces of their cyberware or electronics for 1 minute; a disabled cyberlimb hangs limp. Hardened chrome shrugs it off. Its 8-shot battery recharges in an hour; spare packs 50eb.

A pistol-sized pulse emitter that cooks circuits and leaves the meat alone.

Class: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol
Range table: Pistol
